topic: Will cold fusion ever be possible?
core_question: Can a specified palladium-deuterium electrochemical state produce a statistically reproducible excess-energy signal accompanied by nuclear products at rates compatible with known reaction channels?

hypotheses.name: measurement_null
hypotheses.prediction: all signals remain within calibrated control and background distributions

hypotheses.name: chemical_thermal_artifact
hypotheses.prediction: apparent excess is explained by recombination, enthalpy, drift, or heat-loss error

hypotheses.name: screened_dd_process
hypotheses.prediction: heat and product channels jointly follow a screened D-D rate model

hypotheses.name: product_suppressed_process
hypotheses.prediction: replicable excess energy requires a mechanism beyond standard D-D branch expectations
